subject: Fix broad npm test regressions after post review fixes
description: Repair the remaining broad `npm test` failures after the post-Subconscious review fixes were integrated. Focused fix suites and runtime smoke already pass, but `npm test` currently reports 190/206 files passed. Fix the real regressions or update stale test fixtures to the current stricter contracts without weakening important behavioral assertions. Known failing suites from integrated verification: dispatcher-model.test.js, endpoints.test.js, filedrop-daemon.test.js, guidance-resolve.test.js, long-note-cluster-ingest.test.js, newly-ready.test.js, note-decay-subsumption.test.js, phase2-integration.test.js, recall-outcome-journal.test.js, sweep.test.js, touch-agent.test.js, workspace-read-target.test.js, workspace-write-target.test.js. Individually rerun also showed filedrop-tasks.test.js, metric-branch-claim.test.js, and sync-route.test.js pass. Representative failures: dispatcher model expected old 'dispatcher sessions cannot claim' but now gets prepare-before-accept; endpoints/newly-ready claim completion doesn't release; filedrop/phase2/workspace-write status writes fail under the new claim/worktree gate; guidance dupClusters missing; long-note source-cluster endpoint returned 404; note-decay vecs[0] fallback/subsumption failed; recall outcome journal terminal status rows missing; sweep timeout; workspace-read search/edge count misses. Make `npm test` pass, then run `npm run test:smoke`.
